request.style: English, deep male solo voice, acoustic guitar, cello, hand drum, atmospheric synth, melancholic, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
They went up through the Negev and came to Hebron
Where Ahiman and Sheshai lived with Talmai
Descendants of Anak in the ancient land
The cities were fortified and very large

[Pre-Chorus]
In the Valley of Eshcol they cut a branch
A single cluster of grapes on a pole between them
Forty days they spent in the scouting
Then they returned to the Wilderness of Paran

[Chorus]
We even saw the descendants of Anak there
In our own eyes we seemed like grasshoppers
The land we traveled through devours the living
And all the people we saw are of enormous size

[Verse]
The whole congregation broke out in a loud cry
The people wept through that dark and fearful night
They grumbled against Moses and Aaron
Saying if only we had died in Egypt

[Pre-Chorus]
Why is the LORD bringing us to this land
Only to fall by the sword and be plundered
Our wives and children would become the spoils
So let us choose a leader and go back

[Chorus]
We even saw the descendants of Anak there
In our own eyes we seemed like grasshoppers
The land we traveled through devours the living
And all the people we saw are of enormous size

[Bridge]
But Caleb quieted the people before Moses
Saying we should go up and take possession
For we are well able to do it
Though the men with him said we cannot attack them

[Chorus]
We even saw the descendants of Anak there
In our own eyes we seemed like grasshoppers
The land we traveled through devours the living
And all the people we saw are of enormous size

[Outro]
Caleb drove out Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai
Hebron belonged to him as an inheritance
Because he followed the LORD wholeheartedly
